name: Anthropic
tagline: AI safety lab behind Claude. Loop: a 90-minute CodeSignal progressive OA (4 levels), a 60-min practical phone screen, then an onsite with more practical coding, system design and a values/culture round.
notes: Most reported: converting profiler stack samples into start/end trace events (with de-noising follow-ups), the multi-level in-memory banking system OA (accounts, activity ranking, transfers with acceptance, merges and historical balances), a same-host web crawler that becomes concurrent, an LRU cache made crash-durable, and a greedy longest-match tokenizer (sometimes as a code-review/debug exercise). Questions are practical, not puzzle-y: interviewers care about clarifying ambiguous rules, working code that passes hidden unit tests, clean incremental design that survives the next level, and talking through concurrency, termination and scaling follow-ups.
